measurement_notes: Cold process includes container/Python startup, universe restoration, public facts, planner and serialization.
Warm iterations 1..3 are new planner calculations in one process; first warming calculation 0 is retained but excluded from the warm median.
Facts+planner excludes already restored universe. These times are not browser click times.
Persistent is a new process reading cold-1 public artifacts, one run per case.
RSS is cumulative process maximum, not per-iteration incremental memory. Cgroup peak includes charged cache.
Host tmpfs preserves test artifacts across app processes, not host reboot; archived files are copied to D with hashes.
No p95 inferred from three observations. Same host may have ordinary production background activity.
